copy.title: AI Chat — a website consultant, built around your business
copy.description: Your company knowledge, customer conversations and confirmed requests in one platform. Discover how AI Chat supports your team.
copy.eyebrow: AN AI CONSULTANT FOR YOUR BUSINESS
copy.heroBody: Bring an AI consultant to your website. Connect your services and documents, help visitors find answers, collect requests and bring your team into the conversations that matter.
copy.heroNote: Your knowledge. Your team. Your control.
copy.greeting: Hello! I can help you explore our studio’s services.

copy.painTitle: When the conversation stops, customers move on.
copy.painBody: Visitors need a clear next step. Give them a place to start a conversation, even when your team is busy.

pains.title: Questions after hours
pains.body: People explore your services in the evening and at weekends, too.

pains.title: The same answers, again

pains.title: Interest without a request

pains.title: Conversations without context

faqs.a: Create a company and assistant, add your materials, configure a website and install the JavaScript widget. Automatic replies require a connected AI model.
The widget can be installed where adding JavaScript is allowed, including CMS websites. Configure the permitted domain and check compatibility with your website’s security policies.
Text-layer PDF, DOCX, TXT and Markdown are supported. You can also write articles and import public pages. Scanned-document OCR is not included.
Yes. A teammate takes over and replies from the operator cabinet. Automatic AI replies stop after the handoff.

faqs.q: How do requests reach my CRM?
faqs.a: Use a company API key and REST API. A signed webhook announces an event, and your external system retrieves the request data. Specific connectors are configured separately.
The cabinet and widget support Russian, English, Czech and German. Response language is configured separately; answer quality depends on the connected model and your materials.
The architecture supports independent RU/EU installations with separate databases and storage. The actual region and processing terms are established when deploying.

faqs.q: What if the knowledge has no answer?
faqs.a: The assistant should explain that verified information is unavailable and offer a teammate’s help. Behavior is configurable, and responses should be tested before publishing.

faqs.q: Does this demo create a real lead?
faqs.a: No. This page uses synthetic data and prepared scenarios. It does not call an AI model or create leads.
